data.name: Splashdown
data.detailed_description:
EVIL FLOATIES BEWARE - I HAVE A WATER GUN

SPLASHDOWN is a top-down shooter inspired by classic Flash games of the 2000s. You play as a boy who has become the last line of defense against the Evil Floatie Empire. Fend them off across various waves and levels to thwart their plot to enslave the human race!

Conquer the lazy river with your trusty water gun, making sure to refill it before you get overwhelmed. Avoid obstacles and enemies, fighting the current of the river and the onslaught of ducks, turtles, and octopuses whose only goal is to sink you!

Ensure victory with unique power-ups dropped by your foes. Turn the tide of battle with a devastating spread shot, infinite water, robot companions, mines, and more

Explore various levels featuring unique set dressing and mechanics, then revisit them to test your skills and your endurance

Upgrade your stats and gear between levels to stand up to new challenges. When the time comes, face the Floatie Emperor and free humanity

Play your way on any Windows or Linux machine, including the Steam Deck. Featuring full support for all major controllers and mouse and keyboard, Splashdown is ready for you anytime, anywhere

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 capable — Intel HD 4000, NVIDIA GTX 400 series, AMD Radeon HD 5000 series or newer
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These requirements are subject to change as the game continues development
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.5 capable — NVIDIA GTX 950, AMD Radeon RX 570 or newer
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These requirements are subject to change as the game continues development
